name: smwgraphics-seifuku-densetsu-pretty-fighter-kyoto-front
title: Seifuku Densetsu Pretty Fighter - Kyoto (Front)
description:
A very pretty detailed rooftop from Seifuku Densetsu Pretty Fighter. It serves both as a background and foreground. I did adjust a tiny bit for it to loop properly.

Use it with a layer 3 background for the best results.

Recommended background scrolling: Constant, Constant.

A good fit for cutscenes or japanese rooftops levels, in general.
